_comment: Curated 'story I remember, not the words' index for Bible search (search_design.md §4.6). Fixes the measured failure mode where a lexical search for a well-known story finds nothing because that exact phrase never occurs in the Synodal text (e.g. «блудный сын» never occurs verbatim in Лк 15, so plain FTS returns Суд 8:33 instead). `tags` is free-text Russian, stemmed by the build script into `tags_s`; `title`/`display_ref` are shown verbatim in the UI. Every book_id/chapter/verse_start/verse_end here is verified against RussianOrthodoxReader/Resources/Bible/rus_synodal.sqlite by Tools/build_bible_db/build_search_index.py before it is inserted — a bad reference is skipped with a printed warning, never shipped silently.
_format: topics: [{title, tags, book_id, chapter, verse_start, verse_end, display_ref}]. verse_start/verse_end may be null for a whole-chapter (or multi-chapter, e.g. Нагорная проповедь) topic — navigation only ever jumps to (chapter, verse_start ?? 1), it does not enforce an end.
